tosty.title: Tosty - Mobile App
tosty.description: Android application that transforms screen time reduction into a playful experience to combat excessive screen time.
tosty.problem: Compulsive device use generates stress, anxiety, and deteriorates attention span and emotional regulation, especially in adolescents.
tosty.solution: A system based on self-regulation and gamification where the well-being of a virtual pet strictly depends on compliance with the time limits set by the user.
features: Virtual pet with visual health states
Real-time usage tracking via native modules
Internal economy system with coins, store, and skins
Daily missions, achievements, and streak system
Social functionality for joint missions with friends
Detailed usage history in a calendar
Limit reminder notifications
tosty.challenges: The biggest challenges were related to utilizing background processes without affecting app performance, implementing mobile usage tracking, and finding an aesthetic that was attractive, unique, and friendly.
tosty.QADescription: To ensure the stability of Tosty, I led the technical validation process, ensuring that each feature meets the defined acceptance criteria in the roadmap.
QAPoints: API Testing: Validation of endpoints and data flows using Postman to ensure the integrity of communication between frontend and backend.
Functional Testing: Execution of manual test plans on critical components of the mobile and web application.
Log Analysis: Monitoring of console and developer tools for proactive detection and debugging of logic errors.
Requirements Validation: Systematic control of project progress against technical roadmap milestones.

porlasfamilias.title: Landing Page - Freelance Project
porlasfamilias.description: Professional landing page for a consulting firm focused on client acquisition and digital presence.
porlasfamilias.problem: The consulting firm lacked a digital platform to centralize its services, present its professional team, and provide confidence to families in complex legal processes.
porlasfamilias.solution: Development of a modern and empathetic interface that organizes intervention categories, presents detailed professional profiles, and facilitates direct contact through integrated forms.
features: Optimized responsive design
Interactive services section
Intuitive navigation focused on user experience
Interactive modals for detailed information
porlasfamilias.challenges: The biggest challenge was balancing a modern aesthetic with the sobriety and trust required for a family counseling service, as well as ensuring perfect adaptability across all devices.
porlasfamilias.QADescription: The QA approach in this project was to ensure an impeccable user experience and smooth navigation, guaranteeing that the landing page meets design and accessibility standards.
QAPoints: Cross-Browser Testing: Verification of visualization and functionality across different browsers.
Responsive Testing: Validation of the layout across multiple resolutions and mobile devices.
Usability Testing: Evaluation of the navigation flow to ensure users can access key information without friction.
Visual Regression: Assurance that the final implementation matches exactly with the Figma designs.

task-management.title: Task Management App
task-management.description: Full Stack project developed to demonstrate technical competence in integrating a modern .NET and React ecosystem.
task-management.problem: The need to validate the architecture of an SPA connected to a robust backend, managing asynchronous operations, real persistence, and deployment across different production environments.
task-management.solution: Development of a RESTful API with ASP.NET Core and Entity Framework, integrated with a PostgreSQL database in Supabase. The React frontend efficiently manages the state to offer a fluid experience.
features: Complete task management (Create, Read, Update, Delete)
Implementation of clean architecture in the backend
Dynamic filters by task status (Pending and Completed)
Modern, responsive, and minimalist user interface focusing on UX
Asynchronous API consumption with Axios
Relational database integrated with Entity Framework Core
task-management.challenges: The main challenges included configuring CORS for secure communication between Vercel and Render, and orchestrating automatic migrations in a cloud PostgreSQL database environment.

chatbot.title: AI Assistant with website context
chatbot.description: Intelligent chatbot designed to integrate into websites, capable of answering specific questions based on the provided site content using semantic search.
chatbot.problem: Generic AI models often hallucinate or lack knowledge of specific business data. A solution was needed for the assistant to respond only with real and updated client information.
chatbot.solution: I implemented a RAG system using C# and the Cohere API. The system pre-processes the site content into vectorized 'chunks' and searches for the most relevant fragment using Cosine Similarity before generating the final response.
features: Semantic search
Seamless integration with Supabase database
Lightweight widget in native HTML/JavaScript for easy integration
Scalable architecture deployed on Render
chatbot.challenges: The biggest challenge was the technical migration of the AI engine from Gemini to Cohere mid-development, which involved rewriting the vector normalization logic, adjusting system prompts (preambles), and ensuring the frontend widget maintained low latency after the infrastructure change.
chatbot.QADescription: In an AI system, QA is critical. My role was to validate that the assistant does not 'hallucinate' and that the semantic search returns precise results based on the real context.
QAPoints: Data Integrity Validation: Tests on the vector search engine to ensure correct information retrieval.
Prompt Testing: Refinement and testing of system prompts to guarantee coherent and safe responses.
Integration Tests: Validation of the connection between the frontend widget and the backend on Render after the infrastructure migration.
Latency Analysis: Performance tests to measure response times of the model after changes in the AI parameters.
